content.content: Every depends_on edge between decisions is covered by at least one evaluation whose evaluates contains the dependent and whose depends_on contains the prerequisite; coverage is complete, with no exceptions.
content.rationale: An uncovered edge asks readers to trust a use no check gates; completeness is what makes every edge navigable-with-confidence — and the gate's independence (own change, stable criteria) is what keeps coverage substantive rather than ceremonial.
